ancient-oak.notes: Fix verified: massive fluted trunk ~1/3 canopy width with buttress root star on all sides (front, 3/4, side, back), broad layered canopy. Trunk reads a touch light/orange vs bark #8a5a35.

forest-ground.notes: Flat 2 m tile, shaded green with tan/brown leaf-litter scatter; reads as the forest floor. Base green is a notch brighter than contract #4a8a3f and litter is sparse.

dead-tree.notes: Gnarled bare snag with twisted taper, pale cut branch tips, mossy base patch; silhouette reads instantly at sprite size.

footpath-straight.notes: Grass shoulders still bright yellow-lawn green, clearly warmer than forest-ground's cooler shaded green; litter present but sparse. Path strip itself meets both edge midpoints.

footpath-corner.notes: Bend curve reads well and endpoints land near edge midpoints, but shoulders share the same too-bright sunny-lawn green as footpath-straight instead of forest-ground's shaded green.

tall-grass.notes: Arcing blade tuft with tan wheat-like seed heads; strong readable silhouette. Seed heads slightly chunky but acceptable.

mushroom.notes: Tan/brown cap cluster on a green mossy mound, white stems; clean, on-palette, reads at sprite size.

rock-cluster.notes: Gray stones with moss cap are on-contract, but the broad pale sandy base disc clashes with the shaded forest-floor green; reads as a beach patch.

reeds.notes: Cattail brown heads and blades read instantly; sandy mound plausible for a stream bank though it sits outside the floor palette.

campfire-out.notes: Clearly the same pit as the lit campfire: same stone ring, pale ash bed, logs collapsed and charred dark. Ash bed could be grayer/less cream.
